items.title: Update Python Dependencies for Enhanced Performance in x402 🚀
items.summary: This PR updates several key Python dependencies, including `x402` from version 2.16.0 to 2.17.0, `tencentcloud-sdk-python` from 3.1.140 to 3.1.145, and `uvicorn` from 0.51.0 to 0.52.0. These updates bring performance improvements and new features, ensuring better compatibility and functionality within the x402 ecosystem.

items.title: Upgrade artifact upload action to version 7 in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the actions/upload-artifact from version 4 to 7, introducing support for direct file uploads and upgrading the module to ESM. Key modifications were made in the CI and extension release workflows to utilize the new version. This change enhances the artifact upload process and ensures compatibility with the latest Node.js features.

items.title: Fix chat components to render correctly in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves a critical issue where the action confirmation card and TikTok publish forms were rendering without any interactive elements. By registering the necessary Element Plus components, all chat cards now display the appropriate inputs, selects, checkboxes, and buttons. A new test has been added to prevent similar issues in the future.

items.title: Enhance Chat Card Styles and Functionality in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update improves the action confirmation card by removing a duplicate tool row and aligning its style with the connector consent card. Key changes include updated corner radii, shadows, and animations for a more cohesive look. Additionally, the TikTok card is now rendered as read-only after confirmation, preventing further edits.
